content.user_title: Choose the Right Claude Code Tool
content.value_statement: Claude Code users can waste time deciding between skills and agents. This skill maps task intent to the right lightweight skill or heavyweight agent.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use a skill versus an agent.
Maps common developer tasks to matching Claude Code skills.
Maps decision-heavy tasks to appropriate agents.
Provides quick references for skill triggers and agent triggers.
Points users to complete agent and skill catalogs for deeper lookup.
Encourages a small recommendation set instead of overloading users.
limitations: It recommends tools but does not run those tools itself.
Its catalogs may become outdated when new skills or agents are added.
It depends on the user describing the task clearly.
It does not verify that a recommended third-party workflow is authorized.

use_cases.title: Route a coding task quickly
use_cases.description: Find the best skill or agent before starting implementation work.

use_cases.title: Teach new teammates the tool catalog
use_cases.description: Show which Claude Code helpers match common project tasks.

use_cases.title: Reduce unnecessary subagent usage
use_cases.description: Use lightweight skills for reference work and reserve agents for complex decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Pick a tool for my task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner user who knows the task but not the catalog.
prompt_templates.prompt: Which Claude Code skill or agent should I use for this task: <describe your task>?

prompt_templates.title: Compare skill and agent options
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants a short recommendation with tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose between a skill and an agent for <task>. Give me the best option and one backup.

prompt_templates.title: Route a multi-step workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: User has several related tasks and wants efficient routing.
prompt_templates.prompt: For this workflow, recommend the right Claude Code skills or agents for each step: <list steps>.

prompt_templates.title: Audit my tool selection plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user wants to avoid overusing agents.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned tool choices for this work. Suggest simpler skills where agents are unnecessary: <plan>.

output_examples.input: I need to find where an API endpoint is defined.
output_examples.output: Use the Explore agent for a targeted lookup. If you only need file names or text matches, start with a file-search style skill.

output_examples.input: I need help designing a migration plan.
output_examples.output: Use the Plan agent because the task needs architecture decisions. Add a database or language skill only if you need reference details.

output_examples.input: I want to learn the right HTTP status code for an edge case.
output_examples.output: Use a REST or API reference skill. A subagent is unnecessary unless you need project-specific design judgment.

best_practices: Start with a skill for lookups, syntax, patterns, and reference material.
Use an agent when the task needs independent reasoning, planning, or broad exploration.
Ask for two or three recommendations when the task spans multiple domains.
anti_patterns: Do not launch heavyweight agents for simple documentation lookups.
Do not choose a tool from keywords alone when the task requires judgment.
Do not use scraping or bypass-oriented recommendations without clear authorization.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps you choose the right Claude Code skill or agent before starting a task.

faq.question: Does it execute tools for me?
faq.answer: No. It recommends the best tool choice and points you to catalog references.

faq.question: When should I choose a skill?
faq.answer: Choose a skill for reference material, known patterns, syntax help, and focused domain guidance.

faq.question: When should I choose an agent?
faq.answer: Choose an agent for planning, broad codebase exploration, complex decisions, or independent review.

faq.question: Can this help with Claude and Codex workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to use?
faq.answer: The skill is mainly documentation. One scraping-related catalog entry should be used only for authorized work.
